text:
maria: @channel quick rollup from the postmortem — below are the outstanding action items I pulled from the doc. please confirm ownership + realistic due date (YYYY-MM-DD). if you need to reassign, call it out. trying to lock these today so we can add to the RCA tracker.

maria: ```
A1: Fix hot-path cache invalidation (root cause) — suggested owner: aj — suggested due: 2026-04-03
A2: Add better observability for model fallback routing (logs + metric) — suggested owner: sam — suggested due: 2026-04-10
A3: Harden autoscaler config to avoid shard imbalance — suggested owner: kyle/eng-infra — suggested due: 2026-04-07
A4: Update runbook with canary rollback steps — suggested owner: olivia — suggested due: 2026-04-02
A5: Product validation of fallback quality threshold — suggested owner: product_amy — suggested due: 2026-04-06

Notes: we need owners and dates or explicit reassignments. I will create the RCA ticket after confirmations.```

aj: I can take A1. 2026-04-05 is safer — need two days to repro + patch + quick canary.

sam: A2: I'll own the logs/metric work but need an infra assist for log retention settings. proposed 2026-04-12. tagging @kyle for infra help.

kyle: I can help infra-side for A2. agree with 2026-04-12. For A3, I want to own the config change but will require a short design review with eng-platform — can we push A3 to 2026-04-14? also linking PR that affects autoscaler: https://git.company/repo/pulls/2345

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026 created and linked to this thread — INC-2026. Owner: maria.

olivia: A4: confirmed. I can do 2026-04-02 but ask that product_amy sanity-check the rollback wording before I merge.

product_amy: A5: I'll run a small validation on a sample of 50 requests and report pass/fail. 2026-04-06 works. can someone add the test vectors to the RCA doc?

aj: @sam I'll need the exact log schema you want before I add the hooks. can you paste a snippet?

sam: sure, quick schema below:
```json
{
  "request_id": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "fallback_trigger": "string|null",
  "latency_ms": "int",
  "cache_hit": "bool"
}
```

kyle: noted on the PR link — I'll link infra changes to A3 and put a doc note for the design review. reassigning part of A3 (scaling policy tuning) to eng-infra-team.

maria: summary so far: A1->aj (2026-04-05), A2->sam + kyle infra help (2026-04-12), A3->kyle + eng-infra (2026-04-14), A4->olivia (2026-04-02), A5->product_amy (2026-04-06). if no objections I'll create INC-2026/RA ticket and add these as subtasks.

olivia: small ask — customer legal needs the rollback wording by 2026-04-03 for compliance signoff. can we accelerate review?

product_amy: I can prioritize review and give a thumbs-up by 2026-04-02 EOD.

aj: fine on dates. I'll start a branch tomorrow and link to INC-2026.

sam: I'll drop the log schema into the RCA doc and ping aj.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll create the RCA subtasks and assign per above. follow-up check-in scheduled: 2026-04-01 at 10:00am PT in #eng (brief async update expected before then). if plans change, update this thread and I'll reflect in the ticket. :thumbsup:
